result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10020). I changed the `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` expression as the sales-rep query and updated the Javadoc to match. The region filter, the closed-ticket exclusion and the mapping are unchanged.

The tests matching `*Ticket*` and `*Region*` ran offline and all passed, with no failures in the surefire reports. I did not add a test for the new order, so the example ordering (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is unverified by a test. Nothing is committed.
